tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List all available viral video & face-swap templates on Trendswap with their template IDs, descriptions, and preview URLs. No authentication required.

tools.name: get_credits_balance
tools.description: Get current credits balance and user information. Requires a valid Trendswap API key in Authorization header.

tools.name: create_generation_job
tools.description: Create an AI face-swap or portrait video generation task. Provide either an image_url (accessible image) or an existing portrait_id, along with the template name and optional resolution.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Check the current status and output of a generation job. When complete, returns the final video URL.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_credits_balance" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get current credits balance and user information. Requires a valid Trendswap API key in Authorization header.
